name: The Productive Prompter article workflow v3.1
capability_boundary: A model can participate only when its host can execute article-flow, call a configured local tool, or be invoked by a configured provider adapter. Writing-model rotation additionally requires a passed bounded canary and an accepted execution receipt.

rules.text: Resolve conflicts by the declared precedence chain; examples never override active controls.
Select narrative person in the approved article recipe; no grammatical person is universal.
Use a recipe target only as guidance and stop when the reader job is complete; house bands are never pass/fail gates.
Do not require a universal article skeleton, workflow count, mental-model section, caution section, checklist, activation header, summary, or closing formula.
Choose citation mode per recipe and validate that mode; model memory is never a citation source.
Use article.md as the canonical private article file and docs/{slug}.html as the canonical public article file for this publication target.
Use bounded, gate-specific repairs and escalate after attempt exhaustion.
Select and evaluate an ending strategy in the article recipe instead of enforcing one closing formula.
Compute maturity from conformance evidence; prose may not self-declare production readiness.
Every material factual claim must be traceable, qualified, fresh enough, and rechecked after drafting and material edits.
Naturalization may not alter locked claims, numbers, dates, names, citations, URLs, uncertainty, commitments, code, or quotations without reopening evidence verification.

Reject U+2014 and encoded em-dash entities on every generated and rendered public surface, including quotations and code; repair by paraphrasing, omission, or reopened verification rather than silent protected-text mutation.

Include diagrams if and when they materially improve comprehension. Default the recipe to auto; do not turn diagrams off merely because an article uses continuous prose or has no section headings. For auto or optional, plan zero to four useful visuals and explain an empty plan with omission_reason. Use required or off only for an explicit article-specific requirement. Bind every included visual to one exact existing heading or unique paragraph, accessible alt text and caption, and claim provenance. Label conceptual mechanisms as inference, not measured results. Render and hash-bind every planned asset; an empty plan still requires a bound empty manifest. Packaging must reject missing or unbound assets.

Keep the protected baseline voice profile immutable; apply each operator voice selection as idempotent provisional runtime evidence, activate a new version immediately, and permit rollback without deleting evidence.

Reserve writing models atomically from the canary-approved ordered experiment pool; bind one route to rough draft, voice probe, and rewrite, and pin and disclose any fallback as a contaminated experiment.

Separate package, publication plan, hash-bound policy approval, execution, and exact live-revision verification; automatic approval is limited to the fixed allowlisted target and a run hold prevents it.
Keep published, accessible, represented for discovery, and indexed as distinct states.
Promote a model route or voice-profile change only from retained fixture results with required human calibration and canary evidence.
Corrections, refreshes, supersessions, and archival require a new scoped plan and must preserve revision history, intended URLs, redirects, navigation, and discovery surfaces.
Verify claims in a fresh bounded context whose objective is independent support and correction, not defense of the draft; prefer a different calibrated route when one is eligible.

In workflow 3.1.0 the voice selection is the only routine human decision. Present the exact passages with native selectable A, B, C console options; use a plain-text letter prompt only when the host lacks a selection control. Require an explicit answer, never a preselected default. A selection automatically continues editing, verification, build, push, and exact live verification without another routine confirmation. Rejecting all three candidates with concrete feedback regenerates the set without learning. An explicit pause, unresolved ambiguity, exhausted repairs, missing capability, merge conflict, publication hold, or permanent live-verification failure remains an explicit stop.

Normalize and scan article prose, title, description, rendered article, cards, and feed against the protected high-confidence phrase policy, excluding code, URLs, and attributed quotations from phrase matching but never from the em-dash rule.
Derive visible drafting-model attribution from accepted execution receipts and retain exact routes, CLI version, timing, retries, fallbacks, URL, and QA results in private experiment history.
Interpret every run under its recorded immutable workflow definition; workflow 2.0.0 runs retain their original state sequence and approval behavior.

lifecycle_states.objective: Plan and publish a factual or editorial correction while retaining the prior revision and receipt chain.
Reverify stale evidence and publish a new revision without silently changing historical receipts.
Replace the article intentionally, preserving its prior URL or an explicit redirect and visible history.
Remove an article from active surfaces while preserving the intended URL, redirect, and archive record.
